source: es-atlas v0.6.0 (Martín González, https://github.com/martgnz/es-atlas), provinces.json, built from Instituto Geográfico Nacional (IGN/CNIG) administrative boundaries. Reprojected here (equirectangular, longitude scaled by cos 40°; Canary Islands in a bottom-left inset, longitude scaled by cos 28.4°) and simplified with Douglas-Peucker on shared topology arcs (no gaps between neighbours).

ceuta_melilla: Drawn at their true geographic position on the North African coast; both are under 8 units across at this scale, so each is a circle path of radius 6 centred on the city so it stays visible and clickable. Their labels are the circle centres.
